images.caption: Favorite moments from 2 days in Szczecin, Poland (2 hours east of Berlin)
We started by following the red line painted on the ground. This leads you on a tour around the classic buildings of the small city.
The lake is surrounded by a lush forest
There are many smaller beaches around the lake. This was my favorite.
Day 2! On our way to a mini hike
This old doggie was living his best life
We were very obviously taking a photo but that didn't stop this older gentleman from wandering in as well. We are just the NPCs in his epic videogame
The architect who designed Paris also designed parts of Szczecin. This park reminded me so much of Tuilleries garden.
I forgot to bring a hair elastic on this trip. Had to get creative with this hat
That's all for now folks! This was my second time visiting Poland and I definitely want to come back! Let me know if you've been and what was your favorite part!

endScreen.title: Thanks for watching :)
endScreen.body: What is this? Despite growing increasingly uneasy sharing my personal info on insta, I still love sharing stories with my friends. I made this as an alternative. Would you use a tool like this? I am considering building it out and need early testers!
